project.name: SlopiFY
project.description: Private, lightweight music streaming web application for friends (100% free tier architecture).

phases.name: UI & Mobile Layout Foundation
deliverables: React 18 + Vite SPA setup with React Router v7
Custom Vanilla CSS3 Design System with HSL tokens, animations, and typography
AppShell component with collapsible desktop sidebar & fixed mobile navigation bar
Sticky/fixed bottom audio player component with responsive controls
Full-screen player overlay with album art, lyrics placeholder, and swipe gestures
Library page with storage bar, search filtering, and song list row grid
Upload page with drag-and-drop dropzone & metadata edit form
Playlists overview grid & Playlist detail page structure
Mobile layout optimization (fixed bottom bars, safe-area-inset, responsive song row grid)

phases.name: Firebase Authentication & User Profiles
deliverables: Firebase SDK initialization (`src/config/firebase.js`) with demo fallback support
Google Sign-In & Email/Password Authentication via Firebase Auth
Global AuthContext & hook (`useAuth`) (`src/context/AuthContext.jsx`)
User profile & storage meta auto-creation in Firestore `users/{userId}` collection
Firestore helper service module (`src/services/firestore.js`)
Interactive Login UI with tab switching, error alerts, and demo mode indicator
Sidebar & MobileNav integration with user profile avatar, display name, and Logout button

phases.name: Cloudflare R2 & Worker Storage API + Cloudinary Cover Art
deliverables: Cloudflare Worker API deployment scaffold (`worker/`) for audio file upload and R2 proxy
HTTP Range request support (`GET /api/audio/:r2Key`) for fast seeking (206 Partial Content)
Client-side ID3 metadata parsing with `music-metadata` in `Upload.jsx`
Cover art extraction and live thumbnail preview
Cloudinary unsigned browser upload for cover art images (`src/services/storage.js`)
Server-side signed Cloudinary asset deletion via Worker (`POST /api/cloudinary-delete`)
Worker & R2 frontend client API service (`src/services/storage.js`) with progress tracking and fallback mode
Firestore `songs` collection writer with atomic global storage byte tracking (`addSongToFirestore`)

phases.name: Real-time Firestore Sync & Player Context
deliverables: Real-time Firestore listener for `songs` collection via `subscribeToLibrary`
Global `PlayerContext` HTML5 Audio engine (play, pause, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, FIFO queue)
Full-screen player overlay with album art gradient backdrop
Queue sidebar panel with drag-to-reorder and remove support
Cross-device playback session sync (`users/{userId}/session/current`) via `saveUserSession` / `subscribeToUserSession`
Navigator MediaSession API integration for native lockscreen/notification controls
Local state persistence via localStorage with hydration on reload
Toast notification system for user feedback

phases.name: Playlists & Sharing System
deliverables: Firestore `playlists` CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
CreatePlaylistModal with cover image upload, privacy toggle, and share code generation
AddSongModal for adding songs to existing playlists
Unique shareable link generation (`/playlist/:shareCode`)
Playlist detail page with song list, reordering, and metadata editing
Song deletion from playlists with confirmation modal
SongCard component with context menu actions (play, queue, add to playlist, delete)

phases.name: Production Deployment & Polish
planned_deliverables: Vercel production deployment with security headers
Cloudflare Workers production deployment for API
End-to-end user flow testing across desktop and mobile devices

storage_tunnel_daemon.provider: Cloudflare Tunnel + Python Firestore Sync Daemon
features: Automated Quick Tunnel creation over HTTP localhost:9000
Authenticated REST sync to Firestore storage_meta/global
Heartbeat health monitoring and auto-restart on network disconnect
Direct HTTP PUT to MinIO covers bucket path
